mira_cs: Morning — weekly check-in for tenant Aster. Quick snapshot: GPU hours W/W -18%, pool saturation hitting ~85% in the 02:00-05:00 UTC window, avg queue depth up from 4 -> 9 jobs, p95 latency +30ms, and a spike of ~24 500/grpc errors last night. Monthly spend +12%. Flagging possible onboarding friction and renewal risk; requesting ops + eng triage.

Tomas_sre: Thanks Mira. Can you paste the exact peak window and a couple sample job ids so we can pull traces?

mira_cs: Peak window 02:10-03:40 UTC. Sample jobs: job-9832, job-9931, job-10005. Observed grpc DEADLINE_EXCEEDED in traces. Snippet from node logs:
```text
GRPC error: DeadlineExceeded at runtime.go:412
serving: node-a3 -> queue backlog 11
```

devika_eng: Looks like backpressure around KV-cache eviction when long-sequence requests hit. Will check compaction/eviction logs on the pool and verify allocator behaviour.

raj_ae: FYI Aster told me they're ramping ML training this month and evaluating infra costs. They'll ask about burst capacity if we can offer it.

mira_cs: Noted — if root cause is long sequences we should recommend prompt-length guidelines as a short-term mitigation. Devika, any ETA for initial findings?

devika_eng: Investigating now. Expect initial findings and a proposed config tweak in 4-6 hours. Likely action: tweak continuous-batching thresholds + adjust KV cache retention for the pool.

infra-bot: [auto] ticket created: INF-3219 "Aster peak grpc deadline_exceeded" assigned to devika_eng.

tomas_sre: Running telemetry query now. Will post node-level CPU/GPU and queue depth.

tomas_sre: Telemetry quick dump: node-a3 GPU%@peak 92%, avg queue depth 9, tail p95 420ms -> 450ms during window. Pushing a temporary autoscale bump on that pool to reduce tail errors :gear:.

mira_cs: Appreciate it. I'll sync with Raj and request a 30min handoff with Aster ops today at 16:00 UTC. Marking this high priority for renewal risk analysis :warning:.

raj_ae: I'll prepare options — short-term burst credits + an enablement session on prompt engineering and cost controls. Please add any targeted docs or snippets.

mira_cs: Adding draft notes to the thread after Devika posts findings. Thanks team.
